item.title: 213 Oinarria
item.description: 213 · Oinarria Founded in the third year of the Age of the Many, which makes it one of the older kingdoms.

item.title: 241 A Role in the Hunt
item.description: 241 · A Role in the Hunt Reachable only from a patron page. If you got here another way, something has gone wrong and you should tell me.

item.title: 300 What You Do
item.description: 300 · What You Do Every class in the Player’s Handbook is available, plus homebrew if you send it to me and it is not absurd. Most classes are a job.

item.title: 460 The Wind Gods
item.description: 460 · The Wind Gods Four of them, one for each quarter of Ventis.

item.title: 470 The Ascendant Gods
item.description: 470 · The Ascendant Gods Mortals who performed the ascension and became gods.

item.title: 214 Starkon
item.description: 214 · Starkon Founded in 3 AM. One of the three kingdoms of the Trois Re, which it calls the Drei Kunig. Capital: Hekatania.

item.title: 216 Regno
item.description: 216 · Regno Founded in 3 AM, the same day as Mathair. The third kingdom of the Trois Re, which it calls the Tre Regis. Capital: Caragna.
